episodes.title: Laser Baby's Day Out
episodes.summary: Laser eyes plus a cute baby equals an evisceration machine that will melt your heart. Before burning it out of your chest. With her laser eyes.

episodes.title: An Animated Short Where Pissed-Off Supes Kill Their Parents
episodes.summary: The title says it all and kinda gives away the ending. Let's just say it's cathartic and messy.

episodes.title: I'm Your Pusher
episodes.summary: Ripped from the pages of the original THE BOYS comics - Billy Butcher, with Terror in tow, terrorizes a narcotics supplier into spiking a certain supe's fix.

episodes.title: Boyd in 3D
episodes.summary: Social media is a dysmorphic lens that warps how we view ourselves and others and numbs us to what's truly important in life. This is about that.

episodes.title: BFFs
episodes.summary: Inject Compound V and get superpowers. Drink compound V and uh… this happens.

episodes.title: Nubian vs Nubian
episodes.summary: Divorce is complicated. Divorce with a kid, even more so. Superheroes getting divorced with a kid who's determined for that NOT to happen? There will be blood…

episodes.title: John and Sun-Hee
episodes.summary: Put on your crying face for this one as an elderly man risks everything to cure his wife's inoperable cancer.

episodes.title: One Plus One Equals Two
episodes.summary: Even a great American hero like Homelander had to start somewhere…
